name: SRG266.exists_lorentzPerp_discriminant_from_graph
statement:
theorem exists_lorentzPerp_discriminant_from_graph (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)),
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧
      Lattice.IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      Lattice.IsLattice ℚ (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      Lattice.IsEven (lorentzPerpForm G x c) (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (lorentzPerpSpace G x c) = 11 ∧
      (∀ y : lorentzPerpSpace G x c, y ≠ 0 → 0 < lorentzPerpForm G x c y y) ∧
      ∃ (S : Lattice.GlueBasis (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 3)
        (T : Lattice.GlueBasis (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 5),
      (lorentzPerpForm G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) =
        lorentzPerpLattice G x c P ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ
          ({lorentzPerpGenerator G hG x c hc B} ∪
            (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B) '' (Set.range S.vec ∪ Set.range T.vec))

statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_norm_mod_even (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)

    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) {z : ratGramSpace G x}
    (hz : z ∈ (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P) :
    ∃ n : ℤ, lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z)
        (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z) = lorentzGramForm G x c z z + 2 * (n : ℚ)

name: SRG266.lorentzIntegralProjection_pair
statement:
theorem lorentzIntegralProjection_pair (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) (z w : ratGramSpace G x) :
    lorentzPerpForm G x c (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B z)
        (lorentzIntegralProjection G x c B w) =
      lorentzGramForm G x c z w - centroidHeight G x c z *
        lorentzGramForm G x c (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) w -
      centroidHeight G x c w * lorentzGramForm G x c z
        (toRatSpace G x (integralGramGenerator G x B)) +
      2 * centroidHeight G x c z * centroidHeight G x c w

theorem exists_lorentzD7Glue_from_graph (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)),
      IsLattice ℚ (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      IsIntegral (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      IsEven (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) = 18 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < lorentzD7Form G x c z z) ∧
      (∀ C, lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc C ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ∧
        lorentzD7Form G x c (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc C)
          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc C) = 4) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)) ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z) ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7)

theorem exists_lorentzMarked_normal_forms_from_graph (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V) :

      (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x ∧
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ Lattice.IsLattice ℚ P ∧
      Lattice.IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      Lattice.IsEven (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      (lorentzGramForm G x c).dualSubmodule P =
        Lattice.torsionPart (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 3 ⊔
          Lattice.torsionPart (lorentzGramForm G x c) P 5 ∧

name: SRG266.exists_lorentzD7_normal_forms_from_graph
statement:
theorem exists_lorentzD7_normal_forms_from_graph (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) :
    ∃ (c : IntegralGramLattice G x)
      (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
      (P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)),
      lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P ∧ IsMaximalIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P ∧
      IsLattice ℚ (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      IsEven (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) ∧
      Module.finrank ℚ (lorentzPerpSpace G x c × (Fin 7 → ℚ)) = 18 ∧
      (∀ z, z ≠ 0 → 0 < lorentzD7Form G x c z z) ∧
      (∀ D, lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ∧
        lorentzD7Form G x c (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D)
          (lorentzD7FrameVector G hG x c hc D) = 4) ∧
      (∀ y, (y, (0 : Fin 7 → ℚ)) ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ↔
        y ∈ lorentzPerpLattice G x c P) ∧
      (∀ z, ((0 : lorentzPerpSpace G x c), z) ∈ lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B ↔
        z ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7) ∧
      (lorentzD7Form G x c).dualSubmodule (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) =
        torsionPart (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) 3 ⊔
          torsionPart (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) 5 ∧
      HasPrimaryNormalForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) 3 2 ∧
      HasPrimaryNormalForm (lorentzD7Form G x c) (lorentzD7Glue G hG x c hc P B) 5 4

theorem lorentzD7OddLift_pair_integral (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)

name: SRG266.lorentzD7_torsionPart_eq_sup_map
statement:
theorem lorentzD7_torsionPart_eq_sup_map (hG : IsHypothetical G) (x : V)
    (c : IntegralGramLattice G x) (hc : (11 : ℤ) • c = integralGramGeneratorSum G x)
    {P : Submodule ℤ (ratGramSpace G x)} (hle : lorentzMarkedLattice G x c ≤ P)
    (hint : IsIntegral (lorentzGramForm G x c) P) (B : SecondSubconstituent G x) (p : ℕ) :

SRG266.Lattice.adeEntry_eq_adeBlockPairing
statement:
theorem adeEntry_eq_adeBlockPairing : ∀ (ts : List ADEType)
    (i j : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts)),
    adeEntry ts i.1 j.1 =
      adeBlockPairing ts (finADEBlockEquiv ts i) (finADEBlockEquiv ts j)
  | [], i, _ => Fin.elim0 i
  | t :: ts, i, j => by
      change Fin (t.rank + ADEType.rankSum ts) at i j
      generalize hi : finSumFinEquiv.symm i = ei
      generalize hj : finSumFinEquiv.symm j = ej
      cases ei with
      | inl i0 =>
          cases ej with
          | inl j0 =>
              have hi' : i = Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) i0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply i, hi]
                rfl
              have hj' : j = Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) j0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply j, hj]
                rfl
              subst i
              subst j
              rw [finADEBlockEquiv_cons_castAdd, finADEBlockEquiv_cons_castAdd]
              simp [adeEntry, adeBlockPairing, ADEType.gram]
          | inr j0 =>
              have hi' : i = Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) i0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply i, hi]
                rfl
              have hj' : j = Fin.natAdd t.rank j0 := by
                rw [← finSumFinEquiv.apply_symm_apply j, hj]
                rfl
              subst i
              subst j
              have hbi : finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts)
                  (Fin.castAdd (ADEType.rankSum ts) i0) = Sum.inl i0 := by
                exact finADEBlockEquiv_cons_castAdd t ts i0
              have hbj : finADEBlockEquiv (t :: ts) (Fin.natAdd t.rank j0) =
                  Sum.inr (finADEBlockEquiv ts j0) := by
                change (Equiv.sumCongr (Equiv.refl (Fin t.rank)) (finADEBlockEquiv ts))
                    (finSumFinEquiv.symm (Fin.natAdd t.rank j0)) = _
                rw [hj]
                rfl
              calc
                adeEntry (t :: ts) _ _ = 0

      ((ψ (Pi.single i 1)).1.1 = 0 ∧ (ψ (Pi.single i 1)).2 = 0)) :
    ∃ a : ι → ℚ, (∀ i, a i = 0 ∨ a i = 1) ∧
      (∀ i, middleCoordinateInclusion n (middleCoordinateProjection n (ψ (Pi.single i 1))) =

    (u : ι → W) (v : ι → U) (p : ι → ℤ)
    (hsB : B.IsSymm) (hsC : C.IsSymm)
    (hlN : IsLattice ℚ N) (hlM : IsLattice ℚ M)
    (hiN : IsIntegral B N) (hiM : IsIntegral C M)
    (heN : IsEven B N) (heM : IsEven C M)
    (hdN : B.dualSubmodule N = N ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range u))
    (hdM : C.dualSubmodule M = M ⊔ Submodule.span ℤ (Set.range v))
    (hpv : ∀ i, p i • v i ∈ M)
    (hcrossN : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → B (u i) (u j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hcrossM : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → C (v i) (v j) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ))
    (hdiag : ∀ i, ∃ k : ℤ, B (u i) (u i) + C (v i) (v i) = 2 * (k : ℚ))
    (hunit : ∀ i (a : ℤ), (a : ℚ) * B (u i) (u i) ∈ (1 : Submodule ℤ ℚ) → p i ∣ a) :
    IsLattice ℚ (glueLattice N M (fun i => (u i, v i))) ∧
      IsEven (prodForm B C) (glueLattice N M (fun i => (u i, v i))) ∧
      (prodForm B C).dualSubmodule (glueLattice N M (fun i => (u i, v i))) =

theorem closedStar_link_has_two_sides {p q : Fin 56} {a : Fin 11}

      r.val ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a →
      s.val ∈ Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a →
      r.val ≠ p → s.val ≠ p → r ≠ s →
      (Q.sparseTriple q r s ↔
        (u ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate q r).vertices ↔
          u ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.coordinate q s).vertices))

    (hz : z ∈ (Q.toCoherentK11System.closedStar p a).erase p)
    (hxq : x ≠ q) (hyq : y ≠ q) (hzq : z ≠ q)
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxz : x ≠ z) (hyz : y ≠ z) :
    (Q.sparseTriple q x y ↔ (Q.sparseTriple q x z ↔ Q.sparseTriple q y z))

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.none_mem_extensionBlock_new

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.ConcreteQSD56.some_mem_extensionBlock_old

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.block_gram_square
statement:
theorem block_gram_square :
    (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) * (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) =
      (45 : ℤ) • (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) +
        (1584 : ℤ) • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix B B ℤ)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_comm
statement: theorem disjointness_comm (b c : B) : D.disjointness b c = D.disjointness c b

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_diag
statement: theorem disjointness_diag (b : B) : D.disjointness b b = 0

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_mul_ones
statement:
theorem disjointness_mul_ones : D.disjointness * (allOnesMatrix : Matrix B B ℤ) =
    (45 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_row_sum
statement: theorem disjointness_row_sum (b : B) : ∑ c, D.disjointness b c = 45

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_square
statement:
theorem disjointness_square : D.disjointness * D.disjointness =
    (36 : ℤ) • (1 : Matrix B B ℤ) - (9 : ℤ) • D.disjointness +
      (9 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_block_gram
statement:
theorem incidence_block_gram :
    D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence =
      (9 : ℤ) • (1 : Matrix B B ℤ) + (3 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix -
        (3 : ℤ) • D.disjointness

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_block_gram_apply
statement:
theorem incidence_block_gram_apply (b c : B) :
    (D.incidence.transpose * D.incidence) b c = (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_column_sum
statement: theorem incidence_column_sum (b : B) : ∑ p, D.incidence p b = 12

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_mul_disjointness
statement:
theorem incidence_mul_disjointness : D.incidence * D.disjointness =
    (12 : ℤ) • ((allOnesMatrix : Matrix P B ℤ) - D.incidence)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_mul_ones
statement:
theorem incidence_mul_ones :
    D.incidence * (allOnesMatrix : Matrix B B ℤ) =
      (56 : ℤ) • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix P B ℤ)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_point_gram
statement:
theorem incidence_point_gram :
    D.incidence * D.incidence.transpose =
      (45 : ℤ) • (1 : Matrix P P ℤ) + (11 : ℤ) • allOnesMatrix

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_point_gram_apply
statement:
theorem incidence_point_gram_apply (p q : P) :
    (D.incidence * D.incidence.transpose) p q = if p = q then 56 else 11

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_row_sum
statement: theorem incidence_row_sum (p : P) : ∑ b, D.incidence p b = 56

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_transpose_mul_rect_ones
statement:
theorem incidence_transpose_mul_rect_ones :
    D.incidence.transpose * (allOnesMatrix : Matrix P B ℤ) =

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.kreinMatrix_square_apply
statement:
theorem kreinMatrix_square_apply (x y : KreinVertex (P := P) (B := B)) :
    (D.kreinMatrix * D.kreinMatrix) x y =
      45 * (if x = y then 1 else 0) + 12 - 12 * D.kreinMatrix x y

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.ones_mul_disjointness
statement:
theorem ones_mul_disjointness : (allOnesMatrix : Matrix B B ℤ) * D.disjointness =

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.ones_mul_incidence
statement:
theorem ones_mul_incidence :
    (allOnesMatrix : Matrix P P ℤ) * D.incidence =
      (12 : ℤ) • (allOnesMatrix : Matrix P B ℤ)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.block_block_block_moment
statement:
theorem block_block_block_moment {b c d : B}
    (hbc : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card = 3)
    (hbd : (D.block b ∩ D.block d).card = 3)
    (hcd : (D.block c ∩ D.block d).card = 3) :
    (∑ e, D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e * D.subsetTrace (D.block c) e *
      D.subsetTrace (D.block d) e) = 4428 + 27 * (D.block b ∩ D.block c ∩ D.block d).card

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.block_intersection_three
statement:
theorem block_intersection_three {b c : B} (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hnot : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card ≠ 0) : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card = 3

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjointness_pair_sum
statement:
theorem disjointness_pair_sum {b c : B} (hbc : b ≠ c)
    (hnot : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card ≠ 0) :
    (∑ e, D.disjointness b e * D.disjointness c e) = 9

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_mul_disjointness_sum
statement:
theorem incidence_mul_disjointness_sum (p : P) (b : B) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.disjointness b e) = 12 - 12 * D.incidence p b

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.incidence_triple_sum
statement:
theorem incidence_triple_sum (p q r : P) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.incidence q e * D.incidence r e) =
      2 + 9 * (if p = q then 1 else 0) + 9 * (if p = r then 1 else 0) +
        9 * (if q = r then 1 else 0) + 27 * (if p = q ∧ p = r then 1 else 0)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.independent_triple_neighbor_moment
statement:
theorem independent_triple_neighbor_moment (x y z : KreinVertex (P := P) (B := B))
    (hxy : x ≠ y) (hxz : x ≠ z) (hyz : y ≠ z)
    (nxy : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x y) (nxz : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj x z)
    (nyz : ¬ D.kreinGraph.Adj y z) :
    (∑ w, D.kreinMatrix x w * D.kreinMatrix y w * D.kreinMatrix z w) = 3

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.point_block_block_moment
statement:
theorem point_block_block_moment {p : P} {b c : B}
    (hp : p ∉ D.block b) (hq : p ∉ D.block c)
    (hbc : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card = 3) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e * D.subsetTrace (D.block c) e) = 315

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.point_disjoint_disjoint_triple
statement:
theorem point_disjoint_disjoint_triple {p : P} {b c : B}
    (hp : p ∉ D.block b) (hq : p ∉ D.block c)
    (hbc : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card = 3) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.disjointness b e * D.disjointness c e) = 3

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.point_point_block_moment
statement:
theorem point_point_block_moment {p q : P} {b : B} (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hp : p ∉ D.block b) (hq : q ∉ D.block b) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.incidence q e * D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e) = 24

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.point_point_disjoint_triple
statement:
theorem point_point_disjoint_triple {p q : P} {b : B} (hpq : p ≠ q)
    (hp : p ∉ D.block b) (hq : q ∉ D.block b) :
    (∑ e, D.incidence p e * D.incidence q e * D.disjointness b e) = 3

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.subsetTrace_block
statement:
theorem subsetTrace_block (b e : B) :
    D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e = ((D.block b ∩ D.block e).card : ℤ)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.subsetTrace_block_affine
statement:
theorem subsetTrace_block_affine (b e : B) :
    D.subsetTrace (D.block b) e = 3 - 3 * D.disjointness b e + 9 * (if e = b then 1 else 0)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.subsetTrace_singleton
statement:
@[simp] theorem subsetTrace_singleton (p : P) (e : B) :
    D.subsetTrace {p} e = D.incidence p e

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.three_disjoint_triple_complement
statement:
theorem three_disjoint_triple_complement {b c d : B}
    (hbcne : b ≠ c) (hbdne : b ≠ d) (hcdne : c ≠ d)
    (hbc : (D.block b ∩ D.block c).card = 3)
    (hbd : (D.block b ∩ D.block d).card = 3)
    (hcd : (D.block c ∩ D.block d).card = 3) :
    (∑ e, D.disjointness b e * D.disjointness c e * D.disjointness d e) +
      (D.block b ∩ D.block c ∩ D.block d).card = 3

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.triple_subsetTrace_expand
statement:
theorem triple_subsetTrace_expand (S T U : Finset P) :
    (∑ e, D.subsetTrace S e * D.subsetTrace T e * D.subsetTrace U e) =
      ∑ p ∈ S, ∑ q ∈ T, ∑ r ∈ U,
        (2 + 9 * (if p = q then 1 else 0) + 9 * (if p = r then 1 else 0) +
          9 * (if q = r then 1 else 0) + 27 * (if p = q ∧ p = r then 1 else 0))

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.triple_subsetTrace_sum
statement:
theorem triple_subsetTrace_sum (S T U : Finset P) :
    (∑ e, D.subsetTrace S e * D.subsetTrace T e * D.subsetTrace U e) =
      2 * (S.card : ℤ) * T.card * U.card +
        9 * ((S ∩ T).card * (U.card : ℤ) + (S ∩ U).card * (T.card : ℤ) +
          (T ∩ U).card * (S.card : ℤ)) + 27 * (S ∩ T ∩ U).card

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjoint_commonTo
statement: theorem disjoint_commonTo (S : Finset V) : Disjoint S (D.commonTo S)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.mem_commonTo

@[simp] theorem mem_commonTo (S : Finset V) (w : V) :

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighbor_trace_le_two
statement:
theorem neighbor_trace_le_two {S : Finset V} (hcard : S.card = 3) {x : V}

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_neighbors_of_mem_side
statement:
theorem biclique_neighbors_of_mem_side {S : Finset V} (hI : D.IndependentSet S)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.boundedTwo_fiber_moments
statement:
theorem boundedTwo_fiber_moments {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α] (U : Finset α)
    (f : α → ℕ) (hle : ∀ x ∈ U, f x ≤ 2) :
    (U.card : ℤ) = (U.filter fun x => f x = 0).card +
      (U.filter fun x => f x = 1).card + (U.filter fun x => f x = 2).card ∧
    (∑ x ∈ U, (f x : ℤ)) = (U.filter fun x => f x = 1).card +
      2 * (U.filter fun x => f x = 2).card ∧
    (∑ x ∈ U, (f x : ℤ)^2) = (U.filter fun x => f x = 1).card +
      4 * (U.filter fun x => f x = 2).card

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.mem_bicliqueOutside
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_bicliqueOutside (S : Finset V) (x : V) :
    x ∈ D.bicliqueOutside S ↔ x ∉ S ∪ D.commonTo S

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors_fiber_card
statement:
theorem bicliqueOutsideNeighbors_fiber_card (S : Finset V) (x : V) (i : ℕ) :
    ((D.bicliqueOutsideNeighbors S x).filter fun y => D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) y = i).card =
      D.neighborCount (D.bicliqueClass S i) x

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.biclique_neighborCount_split
statement:
theorem biclique_neighborCount_split (S : Finset V) (x : V) :

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_self
statement:
theorem commonCount_self (T : Finset V) (x : V) :
    D.commonCount T x x = D.neighborCount T x

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_union
statement:
theorem commonCount_union (T U : Finset V) (hd : Disjoint T U) (x y : V) :
    D.commonCount (T ∪ U) x y = D.commonCount T x y + D.commonCount U x y

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.disjoint_biclique_class
statement:
theorem disjoint_biclique_class (S : Finset V) (i : ℕ) :
    Disjoint (S ∪ D.commonTo S) (D.bicliqueClass S i)

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.mem_bicliqueClass
statement:
@[simp] theorem mem_bicliqueClass (S : Finset V) (i : ℕ) (x : V) :
    x ∈ D.bicliqueClass S i ↔ x ∉ S ∪ D.commonTo S ∧
      D.neighborCount (S ∪ D.commonTo S) x = i

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighborCount_union
statement:
theorem neighborCount_union (T U : Finset V) (hd : Disjoint T U) (x : V) :
    D.neighborCount (T ∪ U) x = D.neighborCount T x + D.neighborCount U x

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_comm
statement:
theorem commonCount_comm (T : Finset V) (x y : V) :

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.natCast_square_sub_nonneg

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.rectangular_gram_square_trace
statement:
theorem rectangular_gram_square_trace {α β : Type*} [Fintype α] [Fintype β]
    [DecidableEq α] [DecidableEq β]

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_eq_inter
statement:
theorem commonCount_eq_inter (T : Finset V) (x y : V) :

statement:
theorem commonCount_le_neighborCount (T : Finset V) (x y : V) :

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.commonCount_mono
statement:
theorem commonCount_mono {T U : Finset V} (hTU : T ⊆ U) (x y : V) :

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighbor_pair_count_bound
statement:
theorem neighbor_pair_count_bound (T : Finset V) (x y : V) :

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.two_common_of_square
statement:
theorem two_common_of_square {S : Finset V} {x y f g : V}

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.class_zero_side_counts
statement:

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.neighborCount_mono
statement:
theorem neighborCount_mono {T U : Finset V} (hTU : T ⊆ U) (x : V) :

theorem no_steinerQuadruple12
    (blocks : Finset (Finset (Fin 12)))
    (hsize : ∀ B ∈ blocks, B.card = 4)
    (htriple : ∀ T : Finset (Fin 12), T.card = 3 →
      (blocks.filter fun B => T ⊆ B).card = 1) : False

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.no_steinerQuadruple_on12
statement:
theorem no_steinerQuadruple_on12 {α : Type*} [DecidableEq α]
    (X : Finset α) (hX : X.card = 12) (blocks : Finset (Finset α))
    (hsize : ∀ B ∈ blocks, B.card = 4)
    (hinside : ∀ B ∈ blocks, B ⊆ X)
    (htriple : ∀ T : Finset α, T ⊆ X → T.card = 3 →
      (blocks.filter fun B => T ⊆ B).card = 1) : False

name: SRG266.QuasiSymmetric.TripleDesign57.mem_crownSlice

name: SRG266.Lattice.connectedComponentMk_componentBlockToVertex
statement:
theorem connectedComponentMk_componentBlockToVertex :
    ∀ (cs : List G.ConnectedComponent) (i : ADEBlockIndex (cs.map typeOf)),
      G.connectedComponentMk (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i) ∈ cs
  | [], i => nomatch i
  | c :: cs, Sum.inl i => by
      simp only [componentBlockToVertex, List.mem_cons]
      left
      exact (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff c (coord c i).1).mp (coord c i).2
  | c :: cs, Sum.inr i => by
      simp only [componentBlockToVertex, List.mem_cons]
      exact Or.inr (connectedComponentMk_componentBlockToVertex cs i)

name: SRG266.Lattice.exists_componentBlockToVertex_eq
statement:
theorem exists_componentBlockToVertex_eq :
    ∀ (cs : List G.ConnectedComponent) (v : V),
      G.connectedComponentMk v ∈ cs →
        ∃ i : ADEBlockIndex (cs.map typeOf),
          componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i = v
  | [], _, h => by simp at h
  | c :: cs, v, h => by
      rw [List.mem_cons] at h
      rcases h with h | h
      · have hv : v ∈ c := (ConnectedComponent.mem_supp_iff c v).mpr h
        obtain ⟨i, hi⟩

theorem graphCartanMatrix_componentBlock :
    ∀ (cs : List G.ConnectedComponent), cs.Nodup →
      (∀ c i j, graphCartanMatrix c.toSimpleGraph (coord c i) (coord c j) =
        (typeOf c).gram i j) →
      ∀ i j : ADEBlockIndex (cs.map typeOf),
        graphCartanMatrix G
            (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs i)
            (componentBlockToVertex G typeOf coord cs j) =
          adeBlockPairing (cs.map typeOf) i j
  | [], _, _, i, _ => nomatch i
  | c :: cs, hnodup, hgram, i, j => by
      have hcnot : c ∉ cs

theorem gramDEntry_sparse {n : ℕ} (hn : 4 ≤ n) (i j : Fin n) :
    gramDEntry n i.1 j.1 =
      (if j = i then 2 else 0) -
      (if i.1 + 3 ≤ n then (if j.1 = i.1 + 1 then 1 else 0) else 0) -
      (if 0 < i.1 ∧ i.1 + 2 ≤ n then (if j.1 = i.1 - 1 then 1 else 0) else 0) -
      (if i.1 + 3 = n then (if j.1 = n - 1 then 1 else 0) else 0) -
      (if i.1 + 1 = n then (if j.1 = n - 3 then 1 else 0) else 0)

    (hB : ∀ y : W, y ≠ 0 → 0 < B y y) (hC : ∀ z : U, z ≠ 0 → 0 < C z z)
    (hi : IsIntegral (prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm 7)) C) L)
    (hD7 : ∀ a ∈ evenCoordinateLattice 7, ((0, a), (0 : U)) ∈ L)

    [AddCommGroup W] [Module ℚ W] [AddCommGroup U] [Module ℚ U]
    {n : ℕ} (i j : Fin n) (hij : i ≠ j)
    (B : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ W) (C : LinearMap.BilinForm ℚ U)
    (L : Submodule ℤ ((W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U))
    (hD : ∀ a, (((0 : W), a), (0 : U)) ∈ L ↔ a ∈ evenCoordinateLattice n)
    (hproj : ∀ r ∈ L, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C r r = 2 →
      r.1.2 ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice n)
    (A : Matrix ι ι ℤ) (hdiag : ∀ a, A a a = 2)
    (φ : (ι → ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] ((W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U))
    (hmem : ∀ z, φ z ∈ L)
    (hpair : ∀ z w, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C (φ z) (φ w) =
      (Matrix.toBilin' A z w : ℚ))

      ∃ z, φ z = r) :
    ¬GramDivisibilityDescent 2 A

    (L : Submodule ℤ ((W × (Fin n → ℚ)) × U))
    (hD : ∀ a, (((0 : W), a), (0 : U)) ∈ L ↔ a ∈ evenCoordinateLattice n)
    (hproj : ∀ r ∈ L, prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C r r = 2 →
      r.1.2 ∈ coordinateIntegerLattice n)

    (e : L ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier)

      prodForm (prodForm B (standardRatForm n)) C u v)
    {f : N.carrier →+ ℤ} (hf : ∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0)
    {ts : List ADEType} (coord : Fin (ADEType.rankSum ts) ≃ simpleRootSet f)

    (c : ℤ) (hc : c ≠ 0)
    (hm : ∀ x y : X, (∑ r ∈ R, F r x * F r y) = (c : ℚ) * F x y) :
    ∃ (N : PDUnimodularLattice n) (e : H ≃ₗ[ℤ] N.carrier),
      (∀ u v : H, ((N.pairing (e u) (e v) : ℤ) : ℚ) = F (u : X) (v : X)) ∧
      Fintype.card (NormTwoRoot N) = R.card ∧
      RootSecondMomentIdentity N c ∧
      (∃ f : N.carrier →+ ℤ,
        (∀ r : NormTwoRoot N, f r.1 ≠ 0) ∧
        Fintype.card (simpleRootSet f) = n ∧
        IsPositiveCartan (simpleRootGraph f) ∧
        (∀ (θ : NormTwoRoot N) (z : simpleRootSet f → ℤ),
          simpleRootCombination f z = θ.1 → 0 < f θ.1 →
          (∀ s : simpleRootSet f, 0 ≤ N.pairing s.1.1 θ.1) →
          c = 2 * ((∑ s, z s) + 1)))
